description: EA-63 (11e 09.07 / 09.02.02 / 09.07.01): a fall-back move made outside the Movement phase follows the fall-back modes. Fixture sm11e_m3a_active (P1 Space Marines active vs P2 Orks), as sm11e_wind_swift_evasion. Setup privileges: the seven WP-M3a detachments, the Ork player 0 CP, every engaged unit counts as having fought, and the Nobz engaged with the Outrider Squad carry WIMP-KICKAZ (Bully Boyz) — an enemy rule that FORCES the desperate escape mode. Everything else is a real click: End Pile-in, End Fight, End Consolidation; the fight_phase_end window offers WIND-SWIFT EVASION on the Outriders as a mode choice — only 'Fall back: Desperate Escape (required)', no Ordered Retreat option; a click on it spends 1 CP and makes ONE HAZARD ROLL PER MODEL before the move (game log); Auto-move and Confirm move finish the fall-back and the unit — not battle-shocked — makes the 09.07 battle-shock roll ('Desperate Escape: ... takes a Battle-shock test'). Before the fix: a plain Use button, hazard rolls only in the debug log, and no battle-shock roll.
